# Zap Funds

> Australian invoice finance broker. One enquiry reaches 200+ lenders; written invoice finance options with lender confirmed rates within 48 hours.

Zap Funds Pty Ltd arranges invoice finance and factoring for Australian companies, turning unpaid invoices into cash within 24 hours. Zap Funds is a broker, not a lender; lenders pay our fee, clients pay nothing upfront.
